categories.question: Which solar-system body has a larger mean diameter?
categories.source: NASA/JPL Solar System Dynamics Planetary and Satellite Physical Parameters: mean diameter = twice mean radius in km (not maximum axis). Eight planets, Ceres/Pluto/Makemake and 19 well-measured round moons at least 200 km across; excludes irregular moons and uncertain dwarf-planet estimates. Display rounded to whole km. Satellite source: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/sats/phys_par/ . Later measurement revisions are reported by verification. URL: https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/planets/phys_par.html Accessed 2026-11-09.
